title: Consent to Carry Counter Meals to an Employee's Pay
content:
Where an employee has eaten at the counter against payroll on their Employee Meal Account, the meals are carried to their pay only on the employee's own consent, since it is their pay packet that meets them. This page governs that consent and what it books.

The charge carried to payroll is fixed only after the largest till transaction rung against payroll on the account carries the allowance application it is owed.

## What it governs

What is governed here is the value the employee consents to have carried to their pay. Once the consent is recorded, the amount shows on the account and reaches the pay packet of the payroll period it is marked with, and the charges awaiting payroll recovery stand higher by that value.

## Giving the consent

This is the employee's own consent and nobody else may give it for them. The desk unlocks the tool `confirm_payroll_charge_accrual_6d54e4b8` and hands it over for the customer themselves to run. The call books a charge entry on the account's transaction ledger for the value stated and marks it with the payroll period the pay office will recover it in.

### Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `meal_account_id` | The reference number of the employee's own Employee Meal Account, as the dining services desk reads it out before the consent is given | An account reference |
| `accrued_amount_usd` | The value the employee is consenting to have carried to their pay, in USD | Recorded to 2 decimal places and rounded half to even at that precision; stored as a positive magnitude; an empty value is not accepted |
| `pay_period` | The payroll period the charge is to be recovered in | Written as YYYY-MM-P followed by one digit for the half of the month, exactly as the desk reads it out from the account's activity; an empty value is not accepted |

### What comes back

A plain confirmation sentence naming the reference of the charge entry booked, the value consented to in USD to two decimal places, the payroll period it will be recovered in and the charges awaiting payroll recovery standing on the account afterwards. The presence of that entry reference is what indicates the consent was recorded.

## Basis Q&A

**Whose action is this?** The employee's own. The tool belongs to the customer, and the desk hands it over rather than running it.

**What stands on the account afterwards?** The charge entry, marked with its payroll period, and a higher figure for charges awaiting payroll recovery.
